description: RFC 9651 (every Atlas header is a Structured Field, §9.6.3): field values, each read as an Item, a List and a Dictionary, with whether it parses and, when it does, its serialisation (the empty string for an empty List or Dictionary: the field is not sent). Read by tools/spec's own parser and checked case by case against http_sf 1.5.0; where they differ (base64 padding, Q-SF-1) the case follows RFC 4648 and is marked. An implementation passes when the same values parse and each serialises to the same text.
